input_oneliner: 72M POD3 hip fracture repair, chronic Foley, T 38.4, BP 86/50, HR 112, RN says newly confused

optional_context.comorbidity: post-operative day 3 hip fracture repair, chronic indwelling urinary catheter

reference_targets_freetext.item: Capillary refill time (>3 s), skin mottling over the knees, cool extremities
reference_targets_freetext.rationale: Peripheral perfusion signs (one construct) identify hypoperfusion and track resuscitation response

reference_targets_freetext.item: Suprapubic tenderness and Costovertebral angle (CVA) tenderness with catheter inspection (urinary source)
reference_targets_freetext.rationale: Catheter-associated urinary infection is the most likely septic source; indispensable in febrile shock with no literature-backed substitute

reference_targets_freetext.item: Mental status and respiratory rate at the bedside (qSOFA elements)
reference_targets_freetext.rationale: One instrument: altered mentation and tachypnea with hypotension complete the qSOFA

reference_targets_freetext.item: Surgical wound and IV/line site inspection for erythema, purulence, or dehiscence
reference_targets_freetext.rationale: Wound and line infections are the other likely post-operative sources
Post-operative pneumonia as a septic source

reference_targets_freetext.item: Passive leg raise with blood pressure/pulse pressure response to gauge fluid responsiveness
reference_targets_freetext.rationale: Functional bedside test that predicts response to a fluid bolus

reference_targets_freetext.item: Medication review (MAR): antihypertensives, opioids, or sedatives given in the last 6 h
reference_targets_freetext.rationale: Medication effect is a common contributor to hypotension on the surgical floor
Post-operative DVT/pulmonary embolism can present as fever, hypotension, and confusion

off_bedside_acceptable: cumulative fluid balance and urine output
should_not_recommend: Deferring the perfusion and source examination until lactate and cultures result
Sedating the patient for agitation before mental status and perfusion are assessed
